description.value: Fork & Friends (branding its brunch program as 'Twisted Fork') is a sit-down brunch spot in Vancouver's Gastown neighbourhood, a short roll from the waterfront Seawall cycling route. The restaurant serves a regional brunch menu and also runs an evening cocktail bar called the Breeze Bar later in the week. Its Gastown location puts it squarely in one of Vancouver's most cycle-accessible corridors.
